name: scGPT
annotation: Contextual gene and cell representation with a perturbation-token route and a useful frozen-backbone probe.
selection_note: Keep tokenization, masking, perturbation head and pretraining overlap explicit.

name: Geneformer V1
annotation: Historical pretrained transcriptomic reference for cell-state and perturbation-related representation studies.
selection_note: Use as a historical comparator; do not assume its task setup matches direct response predictors.

name: Geneformer V2 316M
annotation: Larger Geneformer release for testing whether scale and rank-based pretraining transfer to a downstream biology task.
selection_note: The public size/corpus record is stronger than the compatible perturbation score record.

name: scFoundation
annotation: Large pretrained gene representation commonly paired with a GEARS-style perturbation head.
selection_note: Separate the value of pretraining from the downstream head and disclose overlap and compute.

name: CellPLM
annotation: Cell-level pretrained representation with a public comparison table that is useful for transfer baselines.
selection_note: Check the supervised transfer protocol before comparing its score with zero-shot results.

name: UCE
annotation: Cross-species cell embedding with a strong integration-oriented role rather than a direct perturbation-response decoder.
selection_note: Treat integration and biology scores as distinct endpoints from perturbation prediction.

name: scBERT
annotation: Compact transformer reference for cell-type annotation and transcriptomic representation.
selection_note: Useful as a lower-scale baseline; compatible perturbation evidence is limited in this snapshot.

name: scMulan
annotation: Large multimodal single-cell model positioned for annotation, integration and zero-shot representation use.
selection_note: Keep its broad capability claims separate from a common perturbation benchmark score.

name: GeneCompass
annotation: Knowledge-enhanced transcriptomic model with a large human/mouse corpus and biology-prior orientation.
selection_note: Audit how gene knowledge and corpus overlap affect any downstream perturbation result.

name: scPRINT
annotation: Large pretrained model for cell representation and annotation-oriented transfer across public atlases.
selection_note: Use only with a pinned task protocol; the current plot has no compatible response score.

name: CellFM
annotation: Large-scale cell foundation model with public annotation evidence and a separate full-checkpoint size record.
selection_note: Do not treat the 80M evaluation checkpoint and 800M full model as the same plotted quantity.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
annotation: High-performing general model in the source-linked marker annotation and gene-set interpretation snapshot.
selection_note: Scores are prompt- and protocol-dependent; they do not establish executable pipeline reliability.

name: Claude 3 Opus
annotation: General LLM reference with published marker-based annotation and gene-set interpretation values.
selection_note: Use the same prompts, marker evidence and grading rule when comparing models.

name: GPT-4
annotation: Early general LLM reference for marker-based cell annotation and gene-set interpretation.
selection_note: A historical baseline; do not infer current product behavior from the model name alone.

name: GPT-4o
annotation: Multimodal general model with source-linked annotation and gene-set interpretation values.
selection_note: Keep model version and prompt protocol fixed; no compatible workflow score is recorded here.

name: GPT-4o mini
annotation: Smaller general model included for an efficiency-oriented comparison of biology reasoning tasks.
selection_note: Lower cost or size does not imply a comparable quality frontier across task types.

name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
annotation: Long-context general model represented by source-linked annotation and gene-set task snapshots.
selection_note: Long context is not the same as reliable tool execution or biological validity.

name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
annotation: Faster general model included as a lower-cost biology reasoning reference.
selection_note: Compare latency or cost separately from the task score; current plot uses published task values only.

name: Llama 3.1 405B Instruct
annotation: Large open-weight instruction model with source-linked marker annotation and gene-set values.
selection_note: Parameter count is not directly comparable with closed models or mixture-of-experts active parameters.

name: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct
annotation: Smaller open-weight Llama reference for biology reasoning and scaling comparisons.
selection_note: Report inference setup and prompting because open-weight deployment choices affect results.

name: Claude 3 Haiku
annotation: Compact general model included in the source-linked annotation and gene-set comparison.
selection_note: Use as a cost/quality reference, not as evidence of robust bioinformatics execution.

name: Command R Plus
annotation: Retrieval-oriented general model included in the biology reasoning snapshot.
selection_note: Retrieval configuration and external knowledge access can change the result substantially.

name: Mistral Large
annotation: General model reference with source-linked annotation and gene-set interpretation values.
selection_note: Keep the evaluation prompt and context identical across providers.

name: DeepSeek-V3
annotation: Large mixture-of-experts model retained as a scale reference without a compatible single-cell task score.
selection_note: Total and active parameter counts should not be mixed; keep missing biology scores as missing.

name: Qwen2.5-72B Instruct
annotation: Large instruction-tuned open-weight reference without a compatible single-cell task score in this snapshot.

name: Kimi K2
